name: AP Internal Linking Helper
author: apsystemslab

sections.description:
AP Internal Linking Helper adds a focused, distraction-free sidebar to the block editor that suggests internal links while you write.

It’s built for writers, bloggers, and small site owners who want better internal link coverage without running a full SEO suite or dealing with complicated setup. The plugin scans your existing posts and pages, then surfaces suggestions you can copy or open directly from the editor.

It’s an editor-only helper – it doesn’t change your theme or front end. There’s no configuration screen, no settings to tune, and nothing for clients to break. Activate it and start getting link ideas on your next post.

Key points:

  • Editor-only helper – it doesn’t change your theme or front end.
  • No configuration required for basic use.
  • Works alongside your existing SEO plugin or workflow.

Need more control?

If you outgrow the free version, AP Link Helper Pro adds:

  • One-click insertion into selected text.
  • More suggestions per post for content-heavy sites.
  • Rules and exclusions to filter what appears.
  • Optional AI-assisted anchor ideas, generated from your own content.

Learn more and purchase Pro here:
https://noo0oobep-eng.github.io/ap-systems-lab-site/

How It Works

  1. Open the editor for a post or page.
  2. In the right sidebar, enable the “AP Link Helper” panel if it isn’t already visible.
  3. As you write, the panel shows internal link suggestions based on your existing content.
  4. Use the Copy link or Open actions to add links quickly without leaving the editor.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ap-internal-linking-helper directory, or install it via the Plugins → Add New screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Open any post or page in the block editor and enable the “AP Link Helper” panel from the right-hand sidebar (Document settings area).
sections.faq:
Does this work with posts and pages?

Yes. It works with standard posts and pages. Custom post types that use the block editor may also work, depending on how they’re registered.

Does it require configuration?

No. It works out of the box. There’s no settings screen required for the free version.

Is there a Pro version?

Yes. AP Link Helper Pro adds one-click insert, more suggestions, rules/exclusions, and optional AI anchor suggestions. You can learn more and buy Pro here:
https://noo0oobep-eng.github.io/ap-systems-lab-site/
